scope: Independent read-only review of post-process FrameGraph resource declarations, pass order, queue states and index mappings. Bloom shader implementation is authored by this reviewer and excluded.
observations: Exposure preparation is declared before the first exposure consumer. Exposure read/write resources are distinct and imported in Common.
Histogram clear precedes read-before-write histogram accumulation, with exposure adaptation reading the completed histogram.
Bloom downsample and reverse upsample each use separate inputs and output resources. The smallest downsample is reused as the lowest upsample input.
All post-process compute dispatches execute on the graphics queue and use NonPixelShaderRead resources. Tone mapping transitions needed inputs to pixel-readable states.
Present restores every exposure, bloom, temporal and frame-local resource to its declared initial state.
Invalid bloom/exposure combinations fail before replacing caller output. Fixed mode and legacy five-argument scene call remain represented by tests.
Readback pass explicitly transitions histogram and exposure output to CopySource after ToneMap. Imported staging resource remains CopyDestination. Present returns source resources to Common.
